about: The built-in ledger version tables (openspec/changes/core-arch/specs/ledger/spec.md LG-1 to LG-3; CORE-ARCH section 4.8), one per known network, keyed by its genesis hash; read and checked by src/ledger/networks.ts. rows: LG-3's runtime-to-ledger mapping, the same for every network: spec_version 22000-22999 (runtime 0.22) and 1000000-1999999 (runtime 1.0.x) to ledger v8, 2000000-2999999 (runtimes 2.0 and 2.1) to v9. genesis: the hash of the network's block 0 and the spec_version of its runtime at genesis, as read from the network's node (source: the node, the day it was read, and the file in this repository holding its answers); null where not read yet, and specVersion null where the runtime at genesis was not read. boundaries: each runtime upgrade, U the block that enacts it and F = U + 1 the first block of the new runtime, each with its height, hash and MNSV spec_version as read from the network's node (source); the F of each boundary is a pin. A boundary not read from a node is not listed (LG-3). Task 0.3 reads the genesis of preprod and stagenet, every runtime at genesis and every boundary.
